title: Maximum Subarray Sum with One Deletion
summary: Given an array of integers, find the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray by optionally deleting one element, ensuring that at least one element remains in the subarray.
statement: Given an array of integers, find the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray by optionally deleting one element, ensuring that at least one element remains in the subarray.
constraints: Delete at most one element while leaving at least one.
hints: Track the best sum ending here with no deletion and with one deletion.
The kept state either starts at this value or extends; the deleted state either extends or deletes this value from the kept state.
Update the answer from both states at every position.
